checks.name: SIEVE: on the U/V reduced games (K0928), for all m<=8000 the watched label dies exactly at the pot-(spf-1) stretch: V label 0 dies holding spf(2m+1) (hot, delta 1) when 2m+1 is composite and survives iff prime; U label m-1 dies holding spf(2m+3)-1 (cold, delta 0) when 2m+3 is composite and survives iff prime; survivors match the committed U/V tables (K0929)

STR2: stretch-2 end-state theorems on the U/V reduced games, V(m) length ceil((m-1)/3) with block losers at labels 1 mod 3 and breaking losers 0/2/3 by m mod 3, U(m) length ceil((m+1)/3) with block losers 2 mod 3 and breaking losers 3/1/0 by m mod 3, the 6-reduction to W3/H3/G3 shapes, and SIEVE3-U (U label m-1 dies in stretch 2 iff m = 0 mod 3); all survivors pinned against the committed tables

LADDER: restricted unified weight ladder F(w,h;n) (first n-h players hold w, last h hold w+1 hot, pot w, ptr 0; rule applies for h=0 all r, or h>=1 with r=0 or r>=h; the open class h>=2 with 1<=r<h is skipped): grids w=2 n<=1000, w=3 n<=800, w=4 n<=250, w=5 n<=150, all h=0..w
W3EXPLORE: deterministic W3/H3/G3 stretch-3 exploration data (end-state shapes by n mod 4, position-0 death levels) pinned by sha256

follows: K0859 (REMO counting recursion, the uniform-board survivor P(C) via theorem D), K0928 (pot formulation, Lemma E/O, Theorem RED reducing P(C) to the U/V reduced games and pinning their tables m<=8000), K0929 (twin prime laws LAW1/LAW2 as conjectures whose mod-6 composite classes this run resolves universally via STR2/SIEVE3-U), K0919/K0926 (P(C) pins C=1..40 and plateau universality anchoring the committed tables)
title: U/V stretch structure for the reduced REMO games and a unified weight ladder: proved STR2-V/U (stretch-2 end states with lengths and loser classes), SIEVE3-U (U label m-1 dies in stretch-2 iff 3|m), the twin-law mod-6 resolution (LAW1 universal on composites C=3 mod 6, C>=9; LAW2 universal on composites C=2 mod 6, C>=8), the 6-reduction V/U -> W3/H3/G3, and LAD h=0 (stretch-w ladder end state for every w, frame induction proof); the restricted ladder F(w,h;n) is machine-verified on four grids (8,282 checks) with the open class h>=2, 1<=r<h excluded; the SIEVE conjecture (death level = spf-1 mechanism) is machine-verified m<=8000 with 0 violations and remains unproven in general
